meta.name: TACEDGE template manifest
meta.note: Machine-readable register of every TACEDGE template. Status values: approved | provisional | in-development | deprecated. Provisional items await founder sign-off (decisions-required D10). Filename convention: TACEDGE_[Template_Name]_v[MAJOR.MINOR].[ext]. Fonts are referenced by name, never distributed: Play, Be Vietnam Pro, JetBrains Mono (Google Fonts, SIL OFL 1.1); office fallbacks Arial / Consolas.

templates.name: Presentation deck
templates.intendedUse: Customer pitches, investor updates, product demonstrations, technical briefings, internal reviews, conference presentations.
templates.notes: 16:9, 22 approved slide layouts, three masters (cover, dark, content). Generated by scripts/generate-pptx.mjs.

templates.name: Meeting minutes
templates.intendedUse: Customer discovery, pilot setup, weekly reviews, workshops, investor and governance meetings.
templates.notes: Decisions and actions first, never a transcript. Action statuses: Open, In progress, Complete, Blocked.

templates.name: Pilot proposal
templates.intendedUse: Initial customer pilot, design partnership, one-project validation, workflow trial.
templates.notes: A narrow, jointly defined validation, not a broad rollout. One-page summary variant: TACEDGE_Pilot_Summary_Template_v1.0.docx. No customer names in the master.

templates.name: Technical / pilot report
templates.intendedUse: Pilot outcomes, implementation reviews, lessons learned, weekly summaries, workflow validation, technical recommendations.
templates.notes: Findings are labelled by kind: observed fact, user feedback, TACEDGE inference, recommendation. Includes document-control and version tables.

templates.name: Letterhead
templates.intendedUse: Formal correspondence on ordinary office printers.
templates.notes: Forest lockup header, contact footer with page numbers. Minimal graphics by design.

templates.name: Legal document
templates.intendedUse: NDA, pilot agreement, statement of work, services agreement, commercial terms, MoU — formatting only.
templates.notes: VISUAL TEMPLATE ONLY. Brand formatting does not replace legal review. Contains no substantive legal clauses.

templates.name: One-page collateral
templates.intendedUse: Customer meetings, pilot briefs, event handouts, workflow summaries, product introductions, case studies.
templates.notes: Blank master + generic example. Word-count limits per area; QR minimum 22×22 mm with 3 mm quiet zone. No customer details in the master (the Hunter Civil leave-behind remains archived prior artwork).

templates.name: Email signature
templates.intendedUse: Standard staff email signature, light backgrounds.
templates.notes: Name, role, phone, email, website, optional hosted brandmark tile. No banners, quotes or social icons. Plain-text twin included.
